payload.claim: The Notes paragraph's claim that "witness will report skip for it" mischaracterizes saffron/gates/core/witness.py::witness_gate: criteria with no declared `mutant` are simply excluded from the `declared` list and never evaluated, so no per-criterion `skip` is attached to the second criterion specifically — the gate's single pass/fail/skip verdict is computed only from criteria 1 and 3, which do carry mutants. This doesn't change what the cell must build (the second criterion is still checked by `tests`, `criteria`, and `revert`), so it costs nothing to leave, but the sentence as written would mislead an operator about what the gate report will actually say.
